scanNote:
5-UNITNING UChINChI BETI (36-bet) - GRAMMATIKA.

Yuqorida chapda YASHIL yorliqda oq '5' va 'Planning Ahead'.

CHAP USTUN:
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Grammar: Future'.
12) 'Study the examples, and complete the rules.' Ostida to'rtta SURAT va gap pufakchalari:
   - vindsyorfingchi dengizda, to'lqinda qiyshaygan → 'Look at him! He's GOING TO fall!'
   - bozorda shlyapali ayol olma tanlayapti → "I'LL TAKE these, please."
   - qariya derazadan tashqariga qarab turibdi → 'I think the weather WILL GET warmer soon.'
   - qora sviterdagi ayol, o'y pufakchasida pushti shlyapa → "I'm GOING TO buy a hat."
• OCh KO'K quti, oq katta harflar bilan 'be going to · will'. Ikkita band, nuqtali joylar:
   - 'We use ......... to talk about FUTURE PLANS and INTENTIONS. We also use ......... to make PREDICTIONS based on WHAT WE CAN SEE.'
   - 'We use ......... for ON-THE-SPOT DECISIONS. We also use ......... to make PREDICTIONS based on WHAT WE THINK OR IMAGINE.'
13) 'Compare the examples. Which sentence expresses a future plan? Which sentence expresses a fixed arrangement?' Ikki surat: oval ramkada uy va divanda o'tirgan oq ko'ylakdagi ayol → ko'k qiya 'She's going to move house.'; ko'chish qutilari bilan to'la xona → ko'k qiya 'She's moving house on Tuesday.'
14) 'Use the list of prompts below to make sentences about what you ARE and AREN'T GOING TO DO after you finish work/school today.' Ikki ustunda o'nta band: walk home, drive home, go shopping, have a snack, visit friends | listen to music, do your homework, watch a film, clean your house, get some exercise.

O'NG USTUN:
15) 'Complete the predictions, using the verbs in the list.' Qiya ro'yxat: take, buy, paint, feed, win, sell. Oltita surat va nuqtali gaplar:
   1 qop poygasida yugurayotgan erkak - 'He IS GOING TO WIN the race.'
   2 'For sale' taxtasi oldida turgan er-xotin va sotuvchi
   3 do'konda erkak ayolga marjon taqmoqda
   4 ko'k futbolkadagi yigit eshik oldida bo'yoq bankasi bilan
   5 ota va bola ko'l bo'yida o'rdaklarga non tashlamoqda
   6 antik xarobalar oldida fotoapparatli ayol
16) 'Put the verbs in brackets into the correct future form. Then, in pairs, use the prompts to act out similar dialogues.' Uchta dialog; har biridan keyin qiya ko'rsatma:
   1 A: What are your plans for the summer? B: We ...... (go) to Jamaica. A: Wow! When ...... (you/leave)? B: On 28th July. • Christmas - Switzerland - 20th December
   2 A: It's very cloudy today. B: Yes. It's ...... (rain). • cold - snow
   3 A: Which extra subjects are you going to study next year? B: I'm not sure yet, but I think I ...... (do) music and dance. • languages - Spanish and Russian
17) Kasseta belgisi: 'Look at the notes, then listen and tick (✓) what Robin is going to do in the summer. Finally, ask and answer questions in pairs, as in the example.' Sakkiz band katakchalar bilan: 1 travel abroad, 2 work as a waiter, 3 start rafting, 4 buy a car, 5 take driving lessons, 6 move house, 7 study Maths, 8 join a gym. Ostida ko'k qiya namuna: 'SA: Is Robin going to travel abroad this summer? SB: No, he isn't. He isn't going to travel abroad.'

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '36'.

exercises.explanationUz:
5-UNITNING ASOSIY GRAMMATIKASI:
KELASI ZAMONNING UCh ShAKLI.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  1) BE GOING TO                  ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  YaSALIShI:
     am/is/are + going to + FE'L

     I AM going to buy a hat.
     He IS going to fall.
     They ARE going to travel.

  INKOR:
     I'm NOT going to ...
     He ISN'T going to ...

  SAVOL:
     AM I going to ...?
     IS he going to ...?


  QAChON IShLATILADI:

  a) OLDINDAN O'YLANGAN REJA,
     NIYaT
     "I'm going to buy a hat."
     (allaqachon qaror qilgan)

  b) KO'RIB TURGANIMIZGA
     ASOSLANGAN TAXMIN
     "Look at him! He's going to
      fall!"
     (⚠ DALIL KO'Z OLDIMIZDA:
      to'lqinda qiyshayib turibdi)


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  2) WILL                         ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  YaSALIShI:
     will + FE'L (BARCha shaxsda bir xil)

     I WILL take these.
     He WILL get warmer.

  ⚠ 'will' dan keyin 'to' YO'Q:
     'will TO take' - XATO!

  QISQARTMA:
     I'll, you'll, he'll, we'll, they'll
     INKOR: won't (= will not)


  QAChON IShLATILADI:

  a) ShU ONDA QABUL QILINGAN QAROR
     (on-the-spot decision)
     "I'LL TAKE these, please."
     (bozorda ko'rdi - shu zahoti
      qaror qildi)

  b) O'YLAGANIMIZGA yoki
     TASAVVUR QILGANIMIZGA
     ASOSLANGAN TAXMIN
     'I THINK the weather WILL get
      warmer soon.'
     (⚠ DALIL YO'Q - shunchaki
      fikr, taxmin)

  ⚠ 'I think', 'I'm sure', 'I hope',
  'probably', 'maybe' - HAMMASI
  'will' bilan yuradi.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  3) PRESENT CONTINUOUS           ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  = ANIQ, KELIShILGAN reja
    (a fixed arrangement)

  "She's MOVING house ON TUESDAY."
  "I'M GETTING a job next summer."

  ⚠ Odatda VAQT ko'rsatiladi
  (on Tuesday, next summer,
   at 7 o'clock).


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ENG MUHIM FARQ                  ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  KO'RIB TURIBMAN → be going to
     "Look at those clouds!
      It's GOING TO rain."

  O'YLAYMAN → will
     "I think it WILL rain
      tomorrow."

  ShU ZAHOTI QAROR → will
     (Telefon jiringlaydi)
     "I'LL answer it!"

  OLDINDAN QAROR → be going to
     "I'M GOING TO answer all my
      emails tonight."

points.uz: REJA/NIYaT + KO'RGANIGA ASOSLANGAN TAXMIN — am/is/are + going to + fe'l
points.noteUz:
⚠ Qoidadagi birinchi ikki bo'sh joyga AYNAN shu
yoziladi.

points.uz: ShU ONDAGI QAROR + O'YLAGANIGA ASOSLANGAN TAXMIN — will + fe'l (barcha shaxsda bir xil)
points.noteUz:
⚠ Qoidadagi keyingi ikki bo'sh joyga AYNAN shu
yoziladi.
⚠ 'will' dan keyin 'to' YO'Q.

points.en: Look at him! He's going to fall!
points.uz: Unga qara! Yiqilib tushadi! — KO'RIB TURGANIMIZGA asoslangan taxmin
points.noteUz:
⚠ DALIL ko'z oldimizda: to'lqinda qiyshayib
turibdi.

points.uz: Shularni olaman, iltimos. — ShU ONDA qabul qilingan qaror
points.noteUz:
⚠ Bozorda ko'rdi va shu zahoti qaror qildi.
⚠ 'be going to' bo'lmaydi - oldindan
rejalashtirmagan.

points.en: I think the weather will get warmer soon.
points.uz: Menimcha, ob-havo tez orada isiydi. — O'YLAGANIMIZGA asoslangan taxmin
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'I THINK' - 'will' ning eng aniq belgisi.
⚠ 'to get warmer' = isimoq (get + sifat).

points.en: I'm going to buy a hat.
points.uz: Shlyapa sotib olaman. — OLDINDAN o'ylangan NIYaT
points.noteUz:
⚠ O'y pufakchasida shlyapa - allaqachon qaror
qilgan.

points.uz: will not qisqartmasi — kelasi zamon inkori

exercises.explanationUz:
QUTIDAGI TO'RT BO'Sh JOY.


TO'LIQ QOIDA:

  • We use BE GOING TO to talk about
    FUTURE PLANS and INTENTIONS.
    We also use BE GOING TO to make
    PREDICTIONS based on WHAT WE
    CAN SEE.

  • We use WILL for ON-THE-SPOT
    DECISIONS. We also use WILL to
    make PREDICTIONS based on WHAT
    WE THINK OR IMAGINE.


⚠ ESLAB QOLISh USULI:

  KO'Z bilan ko'rsam → going to
  MIYa bilan o'ylasam → will

items.textEn: We use ___ to talk about future plans and intentions.
items.hintUz: reja va niyat uchun qaysi shakl?
items.whyUz:
⚠ REJA/NIYaT → 'be going to'.
⚠ "I'm going to buy a hat."

items.textEn: We also use ___ to make predictions based on what we can see.
items.whyUz:
⚠ KO'Z bilan ko'rsam → 'be going to'.
⚠ "Look at him! He's going to fall!"

⚠ ShU ZAHOTI qaror → 'will'.
⚠ "I'll take these, please."

items.textEn: We also use ___ to make predictions based on what we think or imagine.
items.whyUz:
⚠ MIYa bilan o'ylasam → 'will'.
⚠ 'I think the weather will get warmer soon.'

exercises.instructionEn: Compare the examples. Which sentence expresses a future plan? Which sentence expresses a fixed arrangement?
exercises.instructionUz: Misollarni solishtiring. Qaysi gap kelajak rejasini bildiradi? Qaysi gap aniq kelishilgan ishni bildiradi?
exercises.explanationUz:
'A PLAN' va 'A FIXED ARRANGEMENT'.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  A FUTURE PLAN (reja)            ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  "She's GOING TO move house."

  ⚠ NIYaT bor, lekin ANIQ SANA yo'q.
  ⚠ Hali hech narsa kelishilmagan.
  ⚠ Suratda: divanda o'tirib uy
  haqida o'ylayapti.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  A FIXED ARRANGEMENT             ║
║  (kelishilgan ish)               ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  "She's MOVING house ON TUESDAY."

  ⚠ ANIQ VAQT bor: 'on Tuesday'.
  ⚠ Hammasi tayyor, kelishilgan.
  ⚠ Suratda: qutilar yig'ilgan,
  yuk mashinasi kutyapti.


⚠ ShAKLLAR JUDA O'XShASh:

  She's GOING TO move  (going to)
  She's MOVING         (present
                        continuous)

  ⚠ Farqni ANIQ VAQT ko'rsatkichi
  ochib beradi.


⚠ 'TO MOVE HOUSE':

  = boshqa uyga ko'chmoq.
  ⚠ 'house' ARTIKLSIZ - turg'un ibora.
  ⚠ 'to move to a new house' ham
  mumkin.

items.textEn: Which sentence expresses a future PLAN?
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'be going to' = NIYaT, lekin aniq sana YO'Q.
⚠ Hali kelishilmagan.

items.textEn: Which sentence expresses a FIXED ARRANGEMENT?
items.uz: Qaysi gap ANIQ KELIShILGAN ishni bildiradi?
items.whyUz:
⚠ PRESENT CONTINUOUS + ANIQ VAQT ('on Tuesday')
= kelishilgan ish.
⚠ Hammasi tayyor.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the list of prompts below to make sentences about what you are and aren't going to do after you finish work/school today.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib, bugun ish/maktabdan keyin nima qilishingiz va qilmasligingiz haqida gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
'BE GOING TO' - TASDIQ va INKOR.


QOLIP:
  I'm going to [fe'l].
  I'm not going to [fe'l].


O'NTA KO'RSATMA:

  walk home       - piyoda uyga bormoq
  drive home      - mashinada uyga
                    bormoq
  go shopping     - xaridga bormoq
  have a snack    - yengil tamaddi
                    qilmoq
  visit friends   - do'stlarni yo'qlamoq
  listen to music - musiqa tinglamoq
  do your homework - uy vazifasini
                    bajarmoq
  watch a film    - film ko'rmoq
  clean your house - uyni tozalamoq
  get some exercise - biroz mashq
                    qilmoq


⚠ 'YOUR' → 'MY':

  Ro'yxatda 'do YOUR homework' deb
  turibdi, lekin O'ZINGIZ haqingizda
  gapirganda 'do MY homework'
  bo'ladi.


⚠ 'TO WALK HOME' - PREDLOGSIZ:

  ⚠ 'walk TO home' - XATO!
  'home' bu yerda RAVISh.
  ⚠ Xuddi shunday: 'go home',
  'drive home', 'get home'.


⚠ 'A SNACK':

  = yengil tamaddi (sendvich, meva).
  ⚠ 'to HAVE a snack' - 'to eat' emas.


⚠ 'TO GET SOME EXERCISE':

  ⚠ 'exercise' bu ma'noda
  SANALMAYDIGAN → 'some'.
  ⚠ Lekin mashq-topshiriq ma'nosida
  sanaladi: 'exercise 5'.
exercises.exampleEn: I'm going to walk home. I'm not going to drive home.
modelAnswers: I'm not going to drive home.
I'm not going to go shopping.
I'm going to have a snack.
I'm not going to visit friends.
I'm going to listen to music.
I'm going to do my homework.
I'm not going to watch a film.
I'm not going to clean my house.
I'm going to get some exercise.

exercises.instructionEn: Complete the predictions, using the verbs in the list.
exercises.explanationUz:
HAMMA JAVOB 'IS/ARE GOING TO'!

  ⚠ Chunki bu taxminlar SURATDA
  KO'RGANIMIZGA asoslangan.


FE'LLAR: take, buy, paint, feed,
         win, sell


TO'LIQ JAVOBLAR:

  1 He IS GOING TO WIN the race.
    (kitobda tayyor namuna)
  2 She IS GOING TO SELL the house.
  3 She IS GOING TO BUY a necklace.
  4 He IS GOING TO PAINT the door.
  5 They ARE GOING TO FEED the ducks.
  6 She IS GOING TO TAKE some pictures.


⚠ 5-BANDDA 'ARE':

  'THEY are going to feed' -
  ko'plik, shuning uchun 'ARE'.
  ⚠ Qolganlarida 'She/He' - 'IS'.


⚠ 'TO TAKE A PICTURE/PHOTO':

  = surat olmoq.
  ⚠ 'to MAKE a photo' - XATO!
  ⚠ 'to take some pictures' -
  'some' chunki bir nechta.


⚠ 'A NECKLACE':

  = marjon, bo'yinbog'.
  ⚠ 'neck' (bo'yin) + 'lace'.
  ⚠ O'qilishi /ˈnekləs/ - oxiri
  'les' emas, 'ləs'.


⚠ 'TO FEED':

  = boqmoq, ovqat bermoq.
  ⚠ Noto'g'ri fe'l: feed - FED - FED.


⚠ 'TO SELL' va 'TO BUY':

  sell = sotmoq (sell - SOLD - SOLD)
  buy = sotib olmoq
        (buy - BOUGHT - BOUGHT)
  ⚠ 2-suratda 'For sale' taxtasi bor -
  demak SOTAdi.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the correct future form.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni to'g'ri kelasi zamon shakliga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
UChALA ShAKL HAM UChRAYDI!


1-DIALOG:
  A: What are your plans for the
     summer?
  B: We ARE GOING TO GO to Jamaica.
  A: Wow! When ARE YOU LEAVING?
  B: On 28th July.

  ⚠ 'plans' so'zi bor → NIYaT →
  'be going to'.
  ⚠ "When are you LEAVING?" -
  PRESENT CONTINUOUS, chunki javob
  ANIQ SANA: 'On 28th July'.

  ⚠ 'are going to go' g'alati
  eshitiladi, lekin TO'G'RI.
  ⚠ Ko'pincha 'We're GOING to
  Jamaica' deb qisqartiriladi.


2-DIALOG:
  A: It's very cloudy today.
  B: Yes. It's GOING TO RAIN.

  ⚠ Bulutlarni KO'RIB turibmiz →
  DALIL bor → 'be going to'.
  ⚠ 'It will rain' bu yerda kamroq
  mos - dalil ko'z oldimizda.


3-DIALOG:
  A: Which extra subjects are you
     going to study next year?
  B: I'm not sure yet, but I THINK
     I'LL DO music and dance.

  ⚠ 'I'M NOT SURE' + 'I THINK' →
  ANIQ EMAS → 'will'.
  ⚠ 'I'll do' - shu onda o'ylab
  aytilgan fikr.


⚠ SANA O'QILIShI:

  '28th July' → 'the twenty-eighth
  of July'.
  ⚠ Yozuvda 'the' va 'of' YO'Q,
  lekin O'QIGANDA bor.
  ⚠ 'ON 28th July' - sana oldidan 'on'.


⚠ 'AN EXTRA SUBJECT':

  = qo'shimcha fan.
  ⚠ 'a subject' bu yerda = o'quv fani.

items.textEn: A: What are your plans for the summer?  B: We ___ (go) to Jamaica.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'PLANS' → NIYaT → 'be going to'.
⚠ 'are going to GO' - fe'l 'go', shuning uchun
ikki marta 'go'ga o'xshaydi.

items.textEn: A: Wow! When ___ (you/leave)?  B: On 28th July.
items.whyUz:
⚠ Javob ANIQ SANA → KELIShILGAN ish →
PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
⚠ Savolda 'are' EGADAN OLDIN.

items.textEn: A: It's very cloudy today.  B: Yes. It's ___ (rain).
items.whyUz:
⚠ DALIL ko'z oldimizda (bulutlar) →
'be going to'.
⚠ "It's going to rain" - 'It IS going to'.

items.textEn: A: Which extra subjects are you going to study next year?  B: I'm not sure yet, but I think I ___ (do) music and dance.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'I'M NOT SURE' + 'I THINK' → ANIQ EMAS →
'will'.
⚠ 'I'll do' deb qisqartiriladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Then, in pairs, use the prompts to act out similar dialogues.
exercises.instructionUz: So'ng juftlikda ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib shunga o'xshash dialoglar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
UCh KO'RSATMA - HAR DIALOG UChUN.


⚠ 1-DIALOG QOLIPI:
  A: What are your plans for [vaqt]?
  B: We're going to go to [joy].
  A: Wow! When are you leaving?
  B: On [sana].


⚠ 2-DIALOG QOLIPI:
  A: It's very [ob-havo sifati] today.
  B: Yes. It's going to [ob-havo
     fe'li].


⚠ 3-DIALOG QOLIPI:
  A: Which extra [fan turi] are you
     going to study next year?
  B: I'm not sure yet, but I think
     I'll do [ikki fan].


⚠ 'SWITZERLAND':

  = Shveytsariya.
  ⚠ O'qilishi /ˈswɪtsələnd/.
  ⚠ Sifati: 'Swiss'
  ('Switzerlandish' XATO).


⚠ 'SPANISH' va 'RUSSIAN':

  ⚠ Til nomlari HAR DOIM KATTA harf
  bilan.
  ⚠ 'languages' - '-ge' + '-s'.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the notes, then listen and tick (✓) what Robin is going to do in the summer. Finally, ask and answer questions in pairs, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Qaydlarga qarang, so'ng tinglang va Robin yozda nima qilishini belgilang (✓). Nihoyat, juftlikda namunadagidek savol-javob qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ AUDIO KERAK - qaysi bandlar
belgilanishini faqat yozuvni
tinglab bilish mumkin.


SAKKIZ BAND:

  1 travel abroad
    - chet elga sayohat qilmoq
  2 work as a waiter
    - ofitsiant bo'lib ishlamoq
  3 start rafting
    - raftingni boshlamoq
  4 buy a car
    - mashina sotib olmoq
  5 take driving lessons
    - haydash darslarini olmoq
  6 move house
    - boshqa uyga ko'chmoq
  7 study Maths
    - matematika o'qimoq
  8 join a gym
    - sport zaliga yozilmoq


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: Is Robin going to travel abroad
      this summer?
  SB: No, he isn't. He isn't going to
      travel abroad.

  ⚠ Demak 1-band BELGILANMAGAN.


⚠ SAVOL QOLIPI:

  IS + ega + GOING TO + fe'l ...?
  ⚠ 'is' EGADAN OLDIN.

  Qisqa javoblar:
     Yes, he IS. / No, he ISN'T.
  ⚠ Qisqa javobda 'going to' YO'Q.


⚠ 'TO TRAVEL ABROAD':

  ⚠ 'abroad' - PREDLOGSIZ!
  'travel TO abroad' - XATO.
  ⚠ O'qilishi /əˈbrɔːd/ - 'a' EMAS.


⚠ 'TO JOIN A GYM':

  = sport zaliga a'zo bo'lmoq.
  ⚠ 'to join' - qo'shilmoq, a'zo
  bo'lmoq (klub, jamoa, zal).


⚠ 'TO TAKE LESSONS':

  = dars olmoq (o'quvchi sifatida).
  ⚠ 'to GIVE lessons' = dars bermoq
  (o'qituvchi sifatida).


⚠ 'MATHS':

  Britaniyada 'Maths', AQShda 'Math'.
  ⚠ Fan nomi - KATTA harf.


⚠ 'A WAITER' va 'A WAITRESS':

  waiter = ofitsiant (erkak)
  waitress = ofitsiant (ayol)

points.en: SA: Is Robin going to travel abroad this summer?  SB: No, he isn't. He isn't going to travel abroad.

patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ DALIL KO'Z OLDIMIZDA → 'be going to'.
⚠ 'will' bu yerda MOS EMAS.

⚠ ShU ZAHOTI qabul qilingan qaror.
⚠ 'will' dan keyin 'to' YO'Q.

patterns.exampleEn: I think the weather will get warmer soon.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'I think/I'm sure/I hope' → 'will'.
⚠ DALIL yo'q, faqat fikr.

⚠ PRESENT CONTINUOUS = KELIShILGAN ish.
⚠ ANIQ VAQT bo'lishi shart.

patterns.formula: Is + ega + going to + FE'L ...? - Yes, he is. / No, he isn't.

⚠ Savolda 'is' EGADAN OLDIN.
⚠ Qisqa javobda 'going to' YO'Q.
